name: @rca/api
description: Cloudflare Worker API: accounts, sessions, profiles, activity digests and files. Runs on Workers + D1 + R2, and fully locally with wrangler dev.

scripts.e2e:api: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && (test -f .dev.vars || cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars) && wrangler d1 migrations apply rca --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler dev --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --var APP_URL:http://localhost:4319 --show-interactive-dev-session=false
